references.text: Repeats the theme of rejoicing before the Lord's presence together with the entire household
Describes again the meal before the Lord's presence with joy over all that one has received
Concerns eating before the Lord's presence and rejoicing with one's household
Commands to rejoice before the Lord your God with the entire household
Mentions the Lord's blessing over all work and everything one undertakes
The Lord blesses everything you do with your hands
The Preacher speaks of eating and rejoicing as a gift from God's hand
That humans can eat and rejoice over their work is a gift from God
The first Christians held meals together with joy and sincerity of heart
